item.title: Falcons Finish in Fifth Place at Region Swim Meet
item.description: Fort Campbell finished in fifth place at the Region I Swim Meet hosted by Hopkinsville High School on Monday. Branson Bussy was fourth in the 200-yard IM in 2:29.76 and fourth in the 100-yard breaststroke in 1:12.96.
